programme.title: Kiko
programme.desc: Kiko tells of a child of a goldfish who is very independent, even though he is an only child. Kiko who is always cheerful has four good friends, namely Lola the discus fish, Ting Ting the crab, Patino the catfish and Poli the betta fish. On the other hand, the antagonists, Karkus the catfish and Pupus the eel, always make Kiko's life chaotic. One day, the lake where Kiko lives is polluted due to the reckless acts of humans, causing Kiko and friends to turn into mutants.

programme.title: Kiko
programme.desc: Kiko, seekor anak ikan mas koki yang sangat mandiri, walaupun ia anak tunggal. Kiko selalu riang dan memiliki empat sahabat baik yaitu Lola si ikan diskus, Ting Ting si kepiting, Patino si ikan patin dan Poli si ikan cupang. Di sisi lain, sosok antagonis, Karkus si ikan lele dan Pupus si belut, selalu membuat ricuh kehidupan Kiko.

programme.title: My Comic Boyfriend S1 E1
programme.desc: Naya realized that her high school days were not as exciting as most other high school teenagers were. While she was seeing Jetta on the iPad with a smile, suddenly a shooting star appeared in the sky. Naya prays that her wish to be Jetta's girlfriend can be a realilty and to accompany her days, and also to be her partner to attend prom party later.

programme.title: My Comic Boyfriend S1 E1
programme.desc: Naya menyadari bahwa masa-masa sekolah menengahnya tidak seasyik kebanyakan remaja lainnya. Saat ia sedang melihat Jetta di iPad sambil tersenyum, tiba-tiba sebuah bintang jatuh muncul di langit. Naya pun berdoa agar keinginannya untuk menjadi pacar Jetta dapat menjadi kenyataan — untuk menemani hari-harinya dan menjadi pasangan Jetta di pesta prom nanti.

programme.title: My Comic Boyfriend S1 E2
programme.desc: Naya woke up and screamed hysterically because she saw the real Jetta lying next to her, smiling sweetly and greeting her. Naya panicked and tried to think clearly about what happened last night, 'Was my wish last night really happening?'. Since then, Jetta always appears and follows Naya wherever she goes and it makes her school friends suspicious.

programme.title: My Comic Boyfriend S1 E2
programme.desc: Naya terbangun dan menjerit histeris ketika melihat Jetta sungguhan sedang berbaring di sampingnya, tersenyum manis, dan menyapanya. Naya panik dan berusaha berpikir jernih tentang apa yang terjadi semalam, “Apakah keinginanku semalam benar-benar terkabul?” Sejak saat itu, Jetta selalu muncul dan mengikuti Naya ke mana pun ia pergi, hingga membuat teman-teman sekolahnya mulai curiga.

programme.title: My Comic Boyfriend S1 E3
programme.desc: Naya asked for Reno's help to hide Jetta in his house. She also prayed to God that Jetta would return to his world since she didn't want to make the situation more complicated. However, Naya couldn't stop herself thinking about Jetta, so he was appeared in her room. She shouted loudly, making her parent come to her room. Will they find out about Jetta?

programme.title: My Comic Boyfriend S1 E3
programme.desc: Naya meminta bantuan Reno untuk menyembunyikan Jetta di rumahnya. Ia juga berdoa kepada Tuhan agar Jetta bisa kembali ke dunianya, karena ia tidak ingin membuat situasi menjadi lebih rumit. Namun, Naya tidak bisa berhenti memikirkan Jetta, hingga akhirnya Jetta muncul di kamarnya. Naya berteriak keras, membuat orang tuanya datang ke kamar. Akankah mereka mengetahui keberadaan Jetta?

programme.title: My Comic Boyfriend S1 E4
programme.desc: Naya was nervous when Queena asked her to introduce her to Jetta. While she was thinking about Jetta, he suddenly appeared and made the canteen's atmosphere lively. At the same time, Majja came and he asked Jetta to leave. There was almost a quarrel, and Queena was furious so that she asked Majja to end their relationship.

programme.title: My Comic Boyfriend S1 E4
programme.desc: Naya merasa gugup ketika Queena memintanya untuk memperkenalkannya kepada Jetta. Saat Naya sedang memikirkan Jetta, tiba-tiba Jetta muncul dan membuat suasana kantin menjadi ramai. Pada saat yang sama, Majja datang dan meminta Jetta untuk pergi. Hampir terjadi pertengkaran, dan Queena yang marah pun meminta Majja untuk mengakhiri hubungan mereka.

programme.title: My Comic Boyfriend S1 E5
programme.desc: Naya's days became different after Jetta arrived. Now Naya can hang out at the mall and spend time with Jetta. At school, Naya is also happy because she can feel friendship with her girl gang, Queena. Naya is starting to experience the excitement of high school as she expected.

programme.title: My Comic Boyfriend S1 E5
programme.desc: Hari-hari Naya menjadi berbeda sejak kedatangan Jetta. Kini Naya bisa hang out di mal dan menghabiskan waktu bersama Jetta. Di sekolah pun Naya merasa bahagia karena bisa merasakan persahabatan dengan geng perempuannya, Queena. Naya mulai merasakan keseruan masa SMA seperti yang selalu ia harapkan.

programme.title: My Comic Boyfriend S1 E6
programme.desc: The fight with Reno makes Naya sad. Jetta comforted Naya and she was even sadder when she found out that her tryout score was bad. Queena goes to Naya's house and tries to cure her sadness. At this moment, Queena saw Naya's journal and found out about Naya's lies about Jetta.

programme.title: My Comic Boyfriend S1 E6
programme.desc: Pertengkaran dengan Reno membuat Naya sedih. Jetta berusaha menghiburnya, namun Naya justru semakin sedih ketika mengetahui bahwa nilai tryout-nya buruk. Queena datang ke rumah Naya dan mencoba menghiburnya. Pada saat itu, Queena melihat jurnal milik Naya dan mengetahui kebohongan Naya tentang Jetta.

programme.title: My Comic Boyfriend S1 E7
programme.desc: For the first time, Naya ran away from home and stayed overnight at Queena's residence. However, Keyla trapped her and forced Naya to undress and smoke. Icha secretly recorded Naya's actions, while Queena remained silent. Naya's mother was extremely angry and made her cry in fear.

programme.title: My Comic Boyfriend S1 E7
programme.desc: Untuk pertama kalinya, Naya kabur dari rumah dan menginap semalam di rumah Queena. Namun, Keyla menjebak Naya dan memaksanya untuk melepas pakaian dan merokok. Icha secara diam-diam merekam tindakan Naya, sementara Queena tetap diam. Ibu Naya sangat marah dan membuatnya menangis ketakutan.

programme.title: My Comic Boyfriend S1 E8
programme.desc: Reno showed a viral Tiktok video of Naya smoking in her room wearing only a bra. Naya fell silent, cried, and almost fainted. The school also called Naya and her Mother to the Guidance Counseling room to confirm the video.

programme.title: My Comic Boyfriend S1 E8
programme.desc: Reno menunjukkan video TikTok viral yang memperlihatkan Naya sedang merokok di kamarnya hanya mengenakan bra. Naya terdiam, menangis, dan hampir pingsan. Pihak sekolah kemudian memanggil Naya dan ibunya ke ruang Bimbingan Konseling untuk mengonfirmasi kebenaran video tersebut.

programme.title: My Comic Boyfriend S1 E9
programme.desc: Naya was sick, at that time she felt her life was over. That night the shooting star happened again, Naya cried. He regretted his ridiculous request for Jetta to come true, but instead it turned everything into a mess. He was desperate to jump from the third floor of his house, luckily his mother came to stop him.

programme.title: My Comic Boyfriend S1 E9
programme.desc: Naya jatuh sakit, dan saat itu ia merasa hidupnya telah berakhir. Malam itu, bintang jatuh kembali muncul, membuat Naya menangis. Ia menyesali permintaannya yang konyol agar Jetta menjadi nyata, karena justru membuat segalanya berantakan. Dalam keputusasaannya, ia berniat melompat dari lantai tiga rumahnya, namun beruntung ibunya datang tepat waktu untuk menghentikannya.

programme.title: My Comic Boyfriend S1 E10
programme.desc: Prom night is coming. At first Naya decides not to come. However, after Reno comes to pick her up, and her Mom convinces her, Naya eventually comes to the prom. She is wearing her mom's vintage dress. Jetta also comes to meet Naya and becomes her dance partner. Finally Jetta says goodbye forever to Naya.

programme.title: My Comic Boyfriend S1 E10
programme.desc: Malam prom semakin dekat. Awalnya Naya memutuskan untuk tidak datang. Namun setelah Reno menjemputnya dan ibunya meyakinkannya, Naya akhirnya pergi ke pesta prom. Ia mengenakan gaun vintage milik ibunya. Jetta juga datang untuk menemui Naya dan menjadi pasangan dansanya. Akhirnya, Jetta berpamitan selamanya kepada Naya.

programme.title: TLC: TV, Love, Cinema S1 E4
programme.desc: Gania, a teacher at a surf course who is close friends with Barata, an art school student whose hobby is painting. Gania has a very beautiful new student named Agnes. Agnes' beauty makes all men fight for her, including Barata. Gania helps Barata approach Agnes wholeheartedly and is even willing to sacrifice her own feelings.

programme.title: TLC: TV, Love, Cinema S1 E4
programme.desc: Gania, seorang pengajar di surfing course yang bersahabat dekat dengan Barata, murid sekolah seni yang hobi melukis. Gania kedatangan murid baru yang sangat cantik bernama Agnes. Kecantikan Agnes membuat semua pria berebut memacarinya termasuk Barata. Gania membantu Barata mendekati Agnes dengan sepenuh hati bahkan rela mengorbankan perasaannya sendiri.

programme.desc: One of the SMBG team members suddenly left the team a week before registration for the Fights of Legend professional league closed. Robin and SMBG members (ZEE, ABBY, SACHA, ODRIE) rushed to find new members. Until finally Robin found a replacement for his team member, namely Bara, a former pro-player who had been accused of cheating in matches.

programme.title: The One S1 E1
programme.desc: Salah satu anggota tim SMBG tiba-tiba keluar dari tim seminggu sebelum pendaftaran liga profesional Fights of Legend ditutup. Robin dan anggota SMBG (ZEE, ABBY, SACHA, ODRIE) pun bergegas mencari anggota baru. Hingga akhirnya Robin menemukan pengganti untuk timnya, yaitu Bara, mantan pro player yang pernah dituduh melakukan kecurangan dalam pertandingan.

programme.title: The One S1 E2
programme.desc: There was a division among SMBG members, should they accept Bara or not? Sacha mediated the debate by persuading team members to accept Bara. After being convinced by Robin, Bara was willing to rejoin the SMBG team. However, the SMBG team has not fully united yet, especially since they received news that their registration for the professional league was rejected.

programme.title: The One S1 E2
programme.desc: Terjadi perpecahan di antara anggota SMBG: apakah mereka harus menerima Bara atau tidak? Sacha menengahi perdebatan tersebut dengan membujuk anggota tim agar menerima Bara. Setelah diyakinkan oleh Robin, Bara bersedia bergabung kembali dengan tim SMBG. Namun, tim SMBG belum sepenuhnya bersatu, terlebih setelah mereka menerima kabar bahwa pendaftaran mereka untuk liga profesional ditolak.

programme.title: The One S1 E3
programme.desc: SMBG registration was rejected because of Bara's track record of cheating in professional matches. Zee wants Bara to leave, but Bara's decision to stay is unanimous. The only route the SMBG team can take to enter the professional league is by winning the semi-professional league.

programme.title: The One S1 E3
programme.desc: Pendaftaran SMBG ditolak karena rekam jejak Bara yang pernah melakukan kecurangan dalam pertandingan profesional. Zee ingin Bara keluar, tetapi keputusan Bara untuk tetap bertahan sudah bulat. Satu-satunya jalan bagi tim SMBG untuk masuk ke liga profesional adalah dengan memenangkan liga semi-profesional.

programme.title: The One S1 E4
programme.desc: The SMBG team started to gain popularity because of Bara. Robin also appointed Bara as captain to boost the team's popularity. This creates a tense atmosphere between Bara and Zee. However, the SMBG team continued to win match after match until they advanced to the final round despite these conditions.

programme.title: The One S1 E4
programme.desc: Tim SMBG mulai mendapatkan popularitas berkat Bara. Robin juga menunjuk Bara sebagai kapten untuk meningkatkan popularitas tim. Hal ini menciptakan suasana tegang antara Bara dan Zee. Namun, tim SMBG terus memenangkan pertandingan demi pertandingan hingga akhirnya berhasil melaju ke babak final meskipun dalam kondisi seperti itu.

programme.title: The One S1 E5
programme.desc: The SMBG team received bad news that funds from their investors were blocked for an undetermined amount of time. With their respective strengths, the SMBG team members finally worked together to raise money to support team operations.

programme.title: The One S1 E5
programme.desc: Tim SMBG menerima kabar buruk bahwa dana dari para investor mereka diblokir untuk waktu yang belum ditentukan. Dengan kekuatan masing-masing, para anggota tim SMBG akhirnya bekerja sama untuk mengumpulkan dana guna mendukung operasional tim.

programme.title: The One S1 E6
programme.desc: Zee received an offer from Indra in the form of money and luxury facilities if he wanted to join the Archon team. Zee has not agreed to this, but this makes it difficult for him to concentrate on carrying out activities with the SMBG team, he is often absent because of the distractions given by Indra. This causes a rift within the SMBG team.

programme.title: The One S1 E6
programme.desc: Zee menerima tawaran dari Indra berupa uang dan fasilitas mewah jika ia bersedia bergabung dengan tim Archon. Zee belum menyetujui tawaran tersebut, namun hal itu membuatnya sulit berkonsentrasi menjalani aktivitas bersama tim SMBG. Ia sering absen karena gangguan yang diberikan Indra. Hal ini menyebabkan keretakan di dalam tim SMBG.

programme.title: The One S1 E7
programme.desc: Bara began to reveal signs of Zee's closeness to the Archon team. The entire team was gathered to share all their feelings and problems while joining the SMBG team. Even though it was filled with various loud arguments, in the end they realized that the whole team was a family and had to be united.

programme.title: The One S1 E7
programme.desc: Bara mulai mengungkap tanda-tanda kedekatan Zee dengan tim Archon. Seluruh tim pun dikumpulkan untuk saling berbagi perasaan dan masalah selama bergabung dengan tim SMBG. Meskipun diwarnai berbagai perdebatan sengit, pada akhirnya mereka menyadari bahwa seluruh tim adalah sebuah keluarga dan harus tetap bersatu.

programme.title: The One S1 E8
programme.desc: Robin managed to overcome interference from the Archon team. Now the SMBG team is ready to face the regional final which will make them champions. In the final, it turns out they faced the Archon team.

programme.title: The One S1 E8
programme.desc: Robin berhasil mengatasi gangguan dari tim Archon. Kini tim SMBG siap menghadapi final regional yang akan mengantarkan mereka menjadi juara. Di babak final tersebut, ternyata mereka harus berhadapan dengan tim Archon.

programme.title: Kiko
programme.desc: Kiko tells of a child of a goldfish who is very independent, even though he is an only child. Kiko who is always cheerful has four good friends, namely Lola the discus fish, Ting Ting the crab, Patino the catfish and Poli the betta fish. On the other hand, the antagonists, Karkus the catfish and Pupus the eel, always make Kiko's life chaotic. One day, the lake where Kiko lives is polluted due to the reckless acts of humans, causing Kiko and friends to turn into mutants.

programme.title: Kiko
programme.desc: Kiko, seekor anak ikan mas koki yang sangat mandiri, walaupun ia anak tunggal. Di sisi lain, sosok antagonis, Karkus si ikan lele dan Pupus si belut, selalu membuat ricuh kehidupan Kiko.

programme.title: Once Upon A Time In Chinatown S1 E1
programme.desc: Ng Jat Man, also known as Amen, was born with speaking and hearing disabilities. His food business, Lomie Amen Pinangsia was inherited by his own child in preservation of their family-owned recipe.

programme.title: Once Upon A Time In Chinatown S1 E1
programme.desc: Ng Jat Man, yang juga dikenal sebagai Amen, terlahir dengan disabilitas berbicara dan pendengaran. Usaha kulinernya, Lomie Amen Pinangsia, diwariskan kepada anaknya untuk melestarikan resep khas keluarga mereka.

programme.title: Once Upon A Time In Chinatown S1 E2
programme.desc: Cap Go Meh is an annual celebration that happens on the 15th day after Chinese New Year, while Ketupat is a traditional cultural food that stems from Indonesia. Ketupat Cap Go Meh is a mixture of Chinese and Indonesian culture acculturation. Mrs. Kartika Tjandra started selling Ketupat Cap Go Meh back in 1963 which is now inherited by her child.

programme.title: Once Upon A Time In Chinatown S1 E2
programme.desc: Cap Go Meh adalah perayaan tahunan yang berlangsung pada hari ke-15 setelah Tahun Baru Imlek, sementara ketupat merupakan makanan tradisional yang berasal dari Indonesia. Ketupat Cap Go Meh adalah hasil akulturasi budaya Tionghoa dan Indonesia. Ibu Kartika Tjandra mulai menjual Ketupat Cap Go Meh pada tahun 1963, yang kini diwariskan kepada anaknya.

programme.title: Once Upon A Time In Chinatown S1 E3
programme.desc: Siauw a Tjiap a family owned establishment since 1923, has been keeping its originality and tastiness throughout generations. The familys 4th generation kept its original family recipe while maintaining its core value: humanizing people.

programme.title: Once Upon A Time In Chinatown S1 E3
programme.desc: Siauw A Tjiap, sebuah usaha milik keluarga sejak tahun 1923, telah menjaga keaslian dan kelezatannya dari generasi ke generasi. Generasi keempat keluarga ini tetap mempertahankan resep asli keluarga sambil menjunjung nilai utamanya: memanusiakan manusia.

programme.title: Once Upon A Time In Chinatown S1 E4
programme.desc: Operated by a group of only women, Bakmi Encim Anggur still sticks firmly to their family and business motto: simplicity and solidarity.

programme.title: Once Upon A Time In Chinatown S1 E4
programme.desc: Dikelola oleh sekelompok perempuan, Bakmi Encim Anggur tetap teguh memegang motto keluarga dan usaha mereka: kesederhanaan dan kebersamaan.

programme.title: Once Upon A Time In Chinatown S1 E5
programme.desc: Yohanna Susanti is one of the pioneers of Nasi Ayam Hainam (Hainam Chicken Rice) in Jakarta and she started to built her business in the year 1970 with her own craftsmanship. Until this day it's renowned around Jakarta. Her child and now, grandchild pays her merits by continuing the family business.

programme.title: Once Upon A Time In Chinatown S1 E5
programme.desc: Yohanna Susanti merupakan salah satu pelopor Nasi Ayam Hainam di Jakarta. Ia mulai membangun usahanya pada tahun 1970 dengan keterampilan dan racikannya sendiri. Hingga kini, Nasi Ayam Hainam buatannya dikenal luas di Jakarta. Anak, dan kini cucunya, meneruskan usaha keluarga tersebut sebagai bentuk penghormatan atas jasa dan perjuangannya.

programme.title: Once Upon A Time In Chinatown S1 E6
programme.desc: Jakarta is a town with thousands of Bakmi (Noodles) varieties with its own dynasties, and one of the most legendary Bakmis in town is Bakmie Acang. The uniqueness of Bakmie Acang is that they make their own noodles traditionally.

programme.title: Once Upon A Time In Chinatown S1 E6
programme.desc: Jakarta adalah kota dengan ribuan ragam bakmi yang memiliki dinasti masing-masing, dan salah satu bakmi paling legendaris di kota ini adalah Bakmie Acang. Keunikan Bakmie Acang terletak pada proses pembuatan mienya sendiri yang masih dilakukan secara tradisional.

programme.title: Once Upon A Time In Chinatown S1 E7
programme.desc: The oldest Beef Kwetiau (a type of Noodle) in Mangga Besar, West Jakarta was incepted in 1973. The business has been continued throughout generations, from selling plates under a food tent to having their own permanent establishment, today.

programme.title: Once Upon A Time In Chinatown S1 E7
programme.desc: Kwetiau Sapi tertua di Mangga Besar, Jakarta Barat, berdiri sejak tahun 1973. Usaha ini telah diteruskan lintas generasi, dari awalnya berjualan menggunakan tenda kaki lima hingga kini memiliki tempat usaha permanen sendiri.

programme.title: Bedah Rumah Lagi S4 E2
programme.desc: Bedah Rumah Lagi is a television program that transforms uninhabitable homes of underprivileged families into safe and comfortable living spaces, while also presenting stories of struggle and new hope for the families.

programme.desc: Bedah Rumah Lagi adalah program televisi yang mengubah rumah tidak layak huni milik keluarga kurang mampu menjadi tempat tinggal yang aman dan nyaman, sekaligus menghadirkan kisah perjuangan dan harapan baru bagi penghuninya.

programme.desc: Rodiah is so annoyed that he kicks Nada out of the house. Meanwhile, Diva was dismissed from the MIC casting event, making her have to rack her brain to find out her father's identity. Diva works together with Rodiah, until she succeeds in uncovering her father's identity. He also met Nada, had a big fight, and asked Nada to open up about her past with Hendra.

programme.title: Menggapai Ikatan Cinta S1 E9
programme.desc: Rodiah sangat kesal hingga ia mengusir Nada dari rumah. Sementara itu, Diva dikeluarkan dari acara casting MIC, yang membuatnya harus memutar otak untuk mencari tahu identitas ayahnya. Diva bekerja sama dengan Rodiah sampai akhirnya ia berhasil mengungkap siapa ayahnya. Ia pun bertemu dengan Nada, terlibat pertengkaran besar, dan meminta Nada untuk jujur tentang masa lalunya dengan Hendra.

programme.title: Beyond Creator Indonesian Youtubers S1 E3

programme.title: Candy Caddy S1 E1
programme.desc: Yasmin is facing difficult situation. Mr. Roma urges her to find another job so she could help alleviate the family's financial problem. Yasmin also has to deal with her possessive boyfriend, Adi, and her younger sister, Yara, who is always inquisitive.

programme.title: Candy Caddy S1 E1
programme.desc: Yasmin sedang menghadapi situasi yang sulit. Pak Roma mendesaknya untuk mencari pekerjaan lain agar dapat membantu meringankan masalah keuangan keluarga. Yasmin juga harus menghadapi pacarnya yang posesif, Adi, serta adik perempuannya, Yara, yang selalu ingin tahu.

programme.title: Candy Caddy S1 E2
programme.desc: Yasmin refuses to work at Adi's grocery store. She chooses to join a caddy workshop. She begins to discover an interesting side of golf, which is not far from her expertise in mathematics. On the other hand, she has heard rumors of harassment of a caddy.

programme.title: Candy Caddy S1 E2
programme.desc: Yasmin menolak bekerja di toko kelontong milik Adi. Ia memilih mengikuti pelatihan caddy. Yasmin mulai menemukan sisi menarik dari olahraga golf, yang ternyata tidak jauh dari keahliannya di bidang matematika. Di sisi lain, ia mendengar rumor tentang pelecehan terhadap seorang caddy.

programme.title: Candy Caddy S1 E3
programme.desc: Mr. Roma is fired. Yasmin has to keep working as a caddy to pay for her college studies. She manages to collect quite a lot of money from the golfers she accompanied. However, Yasmin also receives uncomfortable gesture from golfers.

programme.title: Candy Caddy S1 E3
programme.desc: Pak Roma dipecat. Yasmin harus tetap bekerja sebagai caddy untuk membiayai kuliahnya. Ia berhasil mengumpulkan cukup banyak uang dari para pegolf yang didampinginya. Namun, Yasmin juga menerima perlakuan yang tidak menyenangkan dari beberapa pegolf.

programme.title: Candy Caddy S1 E4
programme.desc: Yasmin starts to enjoy her job as a caddy. The presence of a young golfer named Ray made her knowledge about golf really increase. Adi, who already knows her job as a caddy, becomes jealous.

programme.title: Candy Caddy S1 E4
programme.desc: Yasmin mulai menikmati pekerjaannya sebagai caddy. Kehadiran seorang pegolf muda bernama Ray membuat pengetahuannya tentang golf semakin meningkat. Adi, yang sudah mengetahui pekerjaannya sebagai caddy, menjadi cemburu.

programme.title: Candy Caddy S1 E5
programme.desc: Yasmin's working hours are reduced, but she is reluctant to be at home because Mr. Roma is always angry. Therefore, Yasmin spends more time with Adi and Ray. Yara begins to complain because she feels that Yasmin no longer cares about her family.

programme.title: Candy Caddy S1 E5
programme.desc: Jam kerja Yasmin dikurangi, tetapi ia enggan berada di rumah karena Pak Roma selalu marah. Karena itu, Yasmin lebih banyak menghabiskan waktu bersama Adi dan Ray. Yara mulai mengeluh karena merasa Yasmin sudah tidak lagi peduli pada keluarganya.

programme.title: Candy Caddy S1 E6
programme.desc: Even though her working hours have been reduced, there are still many golfers who want Yasmin to accompany them. As a result, other caddies don't get enough clients. One of them is Monik, whose relationship with Pak Chris is strained. An incident at the golf club make things more complicated.

programme.title: Candy Caddy S1 E6
programme.desc: Meskipun jam kerjanya telah dikurangi, masih banyak pegolf yang ingin didampingi oleh Yasmin. Akibatnya, caddy lain tidak mendapatkan cukup klien. Salah satunya adalah Monik, yang hubungannya dengan Pak Chris sedang tidak baik. Sebuah insiden di klub golf membuat keadaan semakin rumit.

programme.title: Candy Caddy S1 E7
programme.desc: Yasmin is happy because her working hours are added again. Her relationship with Ray is getting closer. However, another problem arises from Monik, her own friend who manages to slander Yasmin and get her fired.

programme.title: Candy Caddy S1 E7
programme.desc: Yasmin senang karena jam kerjanya kembali ditambah. Hubungannya dengan Ray pun semakin dekat. Namun, masalah lain muncul dari Monik, temannya sendiri, yang berhasil memfitnah Yasmin hingga membuatnya dipecat.

programme.title: Candy Caddy S1 E8
programme.desc: Yasmin has not been able to overcome the unfair treatment she has received. She chooses to post her rant on Twitter. From there, she receives a lot of support to speak up more.

programme.title: Candy Caddy S1 E8
programme.desc: Yasmin belum mampu mengatasi perlakuan tidak adil yang ia terima. Ia memilih untuk mengunggah keluhannya di Twitter. Dari sana, ia mendapatkan banyak dukungan untuk berbicara lebih lantang.

programme.title: Candy Caddy S1 E9
programme.desc: Ray tries to fight for justice and help Yasmin get her job back. On the other hand, Yasmin's rant on Twitter is getting viral and she even receives responses from people who oppose her.

programme.title: Candy Caddy S1 E9
programme.desc: Ray berusaha memperjuangkan keadilan dan membantu Yasmin mendapatkan kembali pekerjaannya. Di sisi lain, keluhan Yasmin di Twitter semakin viral dan ia bahkan menerima tanggapan dari orang-orang yang menentangnya.

programme.title: Candy Caddy S1 E10
programme.desc: Yasmin manages to solve all her problems, especially lying with her family all this time. She explains everything to the end, then she is focused on participating in the upcoming tournament.

programme.title: Candy Caddy S1 E10
programme.desc: Yasmin berhasil menyelesaikan semua masalahnya, terutama kebohongan yang selama ini ia lakukan kepada keluarganya. Ia menjelaskan semuanya sampai tuntas, lalu fokus untuk mengikuti turnamen yang akan datang.

programme.title: Piknik Pesona S1 E3
programme.desc: When the earthquake occurred, Julius (Ricky Malau), a prisoner, received a message that his hometown was in danger of a tsunami. Julius is allowed to go home to help Mama Emola, his old mother, who lives alone. On the way to the village, Julius, accompanied by Nuri, a young female prison warden, witnessed residents disguised as evacuation officers robbing homes.

programme.title: Piknik Pesona S1 E3
programme.desc: Ketika gempa bumi terjadi, Julius (Ricky Malau), seorang narapidana, menerima kabar bahwa kampung halamannya terancam tsunami. Dalam perjalanan menuju desa, Julius yang ditemani Nuri, seorang sipir penjara perempuan muda, menyaksikan warga yang menyamar sebagai petugas evakuasi menjarah rumah-rumah penduduk.

programme.title: Kiko
programme.desc: Kiko tells of a child of a goldfish who is very independent, even though he is an only child. Kiko who is always cheerful has four good friends, namely Lola the discus fish, Ting Ting the crab, Patino the catfish and Poli the betta fish. On the other hand, the antagonists, Karkus the catfish and Pupus the eel, always make Kiko's life chaotic. One day, the lake where Kiko lives is polluted due to the reckless acts of humans, causing Kiko and friends to turn into mutants.

programme.title: Kiko
programme.desc: Kiko, seekor anak ikan mas koki yang sangat mandiri, walaupun ia anak tunggal. Kiko selalu riang dan memiliki empat sahabat baik yaitu Lola si ikan diskus, Ting Ting si kepiting, Patino si ikan patin dan Poli si ikan cupang. Di sisi lain, sosok antagonis, Karkus si ikan lele dan Pupus si belut, selalu membuat ricuh kehidupan Kiko.

programme.title: Have a Nice Date S1 E1
programme.desc: After 4 years of dating Reno, Natasha (Vonny) finds Reno (Nuca Idol) cheating on her with a popular girl on campus, named Rianti. Jessica (Cathy), Natasha's best friend who has a lot of experience in the dating scene, invites Natasha to find a replacement for Reno through a matchmaking application, named "Have a Nice Date."

programme.title: Have a Nice Date S1 E1
programme.desc: Setelah 4 tahun berpacaran dengan Reno, Natasha (Vonny) mendapati Reno (Nuca Idol) berselingkuh dengan seorang gadis populer di kampus bernama Rianti. Jessica (Cathy), sahabat Natasha yang sudah berpengalaman dalam dunia percintaan, mengajak Natasha untuk mencari pengganti Reno melalui sebuah aplikasi kencan bernama “Have a Nice Date.”

programme.title: Have a Nice Date S1 E2
programme.desc: After playing the matchmaking app for a while, Natasha meets Ricko, a man who is very active in sports. Ricko tells Natasha a lot about all kinds of things related to the world of health. Natasha who is attracted to Ricko tries to follow his lifestyle.

programme.title: Have a Nice Date S1 E2
programme.desc: Setelah beberapa waktu menggunakan aplikasi kencan tersebut, Natasha bertemu dengan Ricko, seorang pria yang sangat aktif berolahraga. Ricko banyak bercerita kepada Natasha tentang berbagai hal yang berkaitan dengan dunia kesehatan. Natasha yang tertarik pada Ricko pun mencoba mengikuti gaya hidupnya.

programme.title: Have a Nice Date S1 E3
programme.desc: After failing on her first date with Ricko, Natasha again tries another date with a successful and rich man named Hansel. Jessica had told Natasha that Hansel is a man with lots of potential.

programme.title: Have a Nice Date S1 E3
programme.desc: Setelah gagal pada kencan pertamanya dengan Ricko, Natasha kembali mencoba berkencan dengan pria lain yang sukses dan kaya bernama Hansel. Jessica telah memberi tahu Natasha bahwa Hansel adalah pria yang memiliki banyak potensi.

programme.title: Have a Nice Date S1 E4
programme.desc: Natasha's series of heartbreaks is still not over. Natasha accidentally sees Rianti and Reno making out. Natasha decides to immediately change her image and she starts looking for other men to take advantage of.

programme.title: Have a Nice Date S1 E4
programme.desc: Rangkaian patah hati Natasha masih belum berakhir. Natasha secara tidak sengaja melihat Rianti dan Reno sedang bermesraan. Natasha pun memutuskan untuk segera mengubah citranya dan mulai mencari pria lain untuk dimanfaatkan.

programme.title: Have a Nice Date S1 E5
programme.desc: Karma is real. The next day, right after Natasha and Gio broke up, Reno comes to Natasha's house because Rianti has just dumped him.

programme.title: Have a Nice Date S1 E5
programme.desc: Karma itu nyata. Keesokan harinya, tepat setelah Natasha dan Gio putus, Reno datang ke rumah Natasha karena Rianti baru saja meninggalkannya.

programme.title: Have a Nice Date S1 E6
programme.desc: Reno still insists on going back to Natasha, to be her boyfriend again. This time, Reno asks his high school friends who were once close to Natasha, to help persuade Natasha to come back with Reno.

programme.title: Have a Nice Date S1 E6
programme.desc: Reno masih bersikeras ingin kembali kepada Natasha dan menjadi pacarnya lagi. Kali ini, Reno meminta bantuan teman-teman SMA-nya yang dulu dekat dengan Natasha untuk membujuk Natasha agar mau kembali bersamanya.

programme.title: Sugar Daddy S1 E1
programme.desc: Derry, a grieving widower, struggles to move on. Aurel, a student drowning in debt not of her own doing, fights to stay afloat. An unexpected series of events brings their lives together, changing them both in ways they never saw coming.

programme.title: Sugar Daddy S1 E1
programme.desc: Derry, seorang duda yang sedang berduka, berjuang untuk melanjutkan hidupnya. Aurel, seorang mahasiswi yang terlilit utang bukan karena perbuatannya sendiri, berusaha keras untuk bertahan. Serangkaian peristiwa tak terduga mempertemukan kehidupan mereka, mengubah keduanya dengan cara yang tak pernah mereka bayangkan sebelumnya.

programme.title: 4 Anak Rantau - Salam Kenal Ibukota
programme.desc: Serial ini mengisahkan empat pemuda yang merantau ke Jakarta demi mengejar cita-cita. Mereka tinggal bersama di sebuah kosan dan menghadapi berbagai tantangan hidup di ibu kota.

programme.title: Roy & Marten Sahabat Sehidup Semati S1 E9
programme.desc: This series follows the story of two close friends, Roy (Tanta Ginting) and Marten (Gading Marten). One day, Roy asks Marten to help open his spiritual perception so that he may communicate with the spirit of his deceased father.

programme.title: Roy & Marten Sahabat Sehidup Semati S1 E9
programme.desc: Berdasarkan nasihat dari campaign manager-nya, Roy memanfaatkan upaya intimidasi yang dialami menjadi sebuah komoditas politik. Sebuah usaha yang membuat elektabilitas Roy semakin meroket. Sayangnya hubungannya dengan Marten semakin terperosok seiring kedekatannya dengan Luna.

programme.title: ABC News Mornings (L)
programme.desc: The show delivers up‑to‑the‑minute news from Australia and around the world, covering politics, economics, culture, sports, and other major events.

programme.title: ABC News Mornings (L)
programme.desc: Acara ini menyajikan berita teraktual baik dari Australia maupun dunia, termasuk topik politik, ekonomi, budaya, olahraga, dan berbagai peristiwa penting lainnya.

programme.title: ABC News At Noon
programme.desc: ABC News, also known as ABC News and Current Affairs, is a public news service produced by the Australian Broadcasting Corporation (ABC). It broadcasts within Australia and the rest of the world, covering both local and world affairs

programme.title: Landline
programme.desc: A tasty sample of stories from the land - covering food, agriculture, crops, climate, business and innovation. We meet fascinating people who make our rural and regional communities unique. Presented by Pip Courtney. (Return)

programme.title: Four Corners
programme.desc: Holding power to account for over 60 Years, Four Corners continues to expose scandals, trigger inquiries, lead national debate and confront the issues that matter to us all. Australia's premier investigative journalism program.

programme.title: Media Watch
programme.desc: Australia's leading forum for media analysis and comment, bringing you a brave and fearless critique of the week's journalism, issues and events in the news. Presented by Paul Barry.

programme.title: Culture By Design
programme.desc: Embark on a creative, cultural journey across Asia and meet the creative visionaries shaping the future of design in this exciting new series, hosted by Professor of Architecture, Anthony Burke.

programme.title: Restoration Australia
programme.desc: Anthony Burke meets self-confessed 'Architecture Nerds' Annette and Michael Pitman who own the smallest of all the Walter Burley Griffin-designed houses in Castlecrag and want to restore and extend the house.

programme.title: Finke
programme.desc: The program showcases the passion of competitors, the extreme challenges of the desert track, and stories of dedication and bravery as they face the harsh wilderness of Australia.

programme.title: Finke

programme.title: Konosuba, Ep 9
programme.desc: High school student Kazuma Satou dies in an unexpectedly embarrassing accident and awakens in the presence of the goddess Aqua. She offers him the opportunity to be reincarnated in a fantasy world to defeat the Demon King. Before leaving, Kazuma is allowed to take one item with him, and he mischievously chooses Aqua herself. Together, the unlikely pair begin their new life in another world, quickly discovering that surviving there is far more difficult than they imagined. Filled with humor, fantasy, and parody, the episode introduces the eccentric characters and comedic adventures that define the series.

programme.title: Konosuba, Ep 9
programme.desc: Kazuma Satou, seorang remaja yang meninggal dalam kecelakaan yang memalukan, bertemu dengan Dewi Aqua di alam setelah kematian. Ia diberi kesempatan untuk bereinkarnasi ke dunia fantasi dan memilih satu benda untuk dibawa. Sebagai balas dendam atas sikap Aqua yang mengejeknya, Kazuma justru memilih sang dewi untuk ikut bersamanya. Setibanya di dunia baru, keduanya segera menyadari bahwa kehidupan sebagai petualang tidak semudah yang dibayangkan. Episode pembuka ini memperkenalkan dunia penuh sihir, monster, dan humor satir yang menjadi ciri khas KonoSuba.

While the production unfolds, Aqua quietly continues his investigation into the mystery surrounding Ai Hoshino's death, uncovering new leads that could change everything. Blending compelling character drama with a behind-the-scenes look at Japan's entertainment industry, Oshi no Ko Season 2 explores talent, obsession, and the price of pursuing the truth.

programme.title: Oshi No Ko S2, Ep 18
programme.desc: Musim kedua menghadirkan perjalanan Aqua, Ruby, Kana, Akane, dan para aktor lainnya dalam mempersiapkan adaptasi panggung Tokyo Blade. Sementara itu, Aqua diam-diam melanjutkan penyelidikannya terhadap sosok yang bertanggung jawab atas kematian Ai Hoshino, hingga menemukan petunjuk baru yang membawa penyelidikannya ke arah yang semakin berbahaya. programme.title: Konosuba, Ep 10
programme.desc: High school student Kazuma Satou dies in an unexpectedly embarrassing accident and awakens in the presence of the goddess Aqua. She offers him the opportunity to be reincarnated in a fantasy world to defeat the Demon King. Before leaving, Kazuma is allowed to take one item with him, and he mischievously chooses Aqua herself. Together, the unlikely pair begin their new life in another world, quickly discovering that surviving there is far more difficult than they imagined. Filled with humor, fantasy, and parody, the episode introduces the eccentric characters and comedic adventures that define the series.

programme.title: Konosuba, Ep 10
programme.desc: Kazuma Satou, seorang remaja yang meninggal dalam kecelakaan yang memalukan, bertemu dengan Dewi Aqua di alam setelah kematian. Ia diberi kesempatan untuk bereinkarnasi ke dunia fantasi dan memilih satu benda untuk dibawa. Sebagai balas dendam atas sikap Aqua yang mengejeknya, Kazuma justru memilih sang dewi untuk ikut bersamanya. Setibanya di dunia baru, keduanya segera menyadari bahwa kehidupan sebagai petualang tidak semudah yang dibayangkan. Episode pembuka ini memperkenalkan dunia penuh sihir, monster, dan humor satir yang menjadi ciri khas KonoSuba.

programme.title: Konosuba S2, Ep 1
programme.desc: High school student Kazuma Satou dies in an unexpectedly embarrassing accident and awakens in the presence of the goddess Aqua. She offers him the opportunity to be reincarnated in a fantasy world to defeat the Demon King. Before leaving, Kazuma is allowed to take one item with him, and he mischievously chooses Aqua herself. Together, the unlikely pair begin their new life in another world, quickly discovering that surviving there is far more difficult than they imagined. Filled with humor, fantasy, and parody, the episode introduces the eccentric characters and comedic adventures that define the series.

programme.title: Konosuba S2, Ep 1
programme.desc: Kazuma Satou, seorang remaja yang meninggal dalam kecelakaan yang memalukan, bertemu dengan Dewi Aqua di alam setelah kematian. Ia diberi kesempatan untuk bereinkarnasi ke dunia fantasi dan memilih satu benda untuk dibawa. Sebagai balas dendam atas sikap Aqua yang mengejeknya, Kazuma justru memilih sang dewi untuk ikut bersamanya. Setibanya di dunia baru, keduanya segera menyadari bahwa kehidupan sebagai petualang tidak semudah yang dibayangkan. Episode pembuka ini memperkenalkan dunia penuh sihir, monster, dan humor satir yang menjadi ciri khas KonoSuba.

Di balik proses latihan dan pertunjukan, persaingan antarpemeran, tekanan untuk memberikan penampilan terbaik, serta dinamika hubungan pribadi menjadi tantangan yang harus mereka hadapi. Sementara itu, Aqua diam-diam melanjutkan penyelidikannya terhadap sosok yang bertanggung jawab atas kematian Ai Hoshino, hingga menemukan petunjuk baru yang membawa penyelidikannya ke arah yang semakin berbahaya. Memadukan drama karakter yang emosional dengan gambaran realistis industri hiburan Jepang, musim ini menyajikan kisah tentang ambisi, pengorbanan, dan pencarian kebenaran.

programme.title: Konosuba S2, Ep 1
programme.desc: High school student Kazuma Satou dies in an unexpectedly embarrassing accident and awakens in the presence of the goddess Aqua. She offers him the opportunity to be reincarnated in a fantasy world to defeat the Demon King. Before leaving, Kazuma is allowed to take one item with him, and he mischievously chooses Aqua herself. Together, the unlikely pair begin their new life in another world, quickly discovering that surviving there is far more difficult than they imagined. Filled with humor, fantasy, and parody, the episode introduces the eccentric characters and comedic adventures that define the series.

programme.title: Konosuba S2, Ep 1
programme.desc: Kazuma Satou, seorang remaja yang meninggal dalam kecelakaan yang memalukan, bertemu dengan Dewi Aqua di alam setelah kematian. Ia diberi kesempatan untuk bereinkarnasi ke dunia fantasi dan memilih satu benda untuk dibawa. Sebagai balas dendam atas sikap Aqua yang mengejeknya, Kazuma justru memilih sang dewi untuk ikut bersamanya. Setibanya di dunia baru, keduanya segera menyadari bahwa kehidupan sebagai petualang tidak semudah yang dibayangkan. Episode pembuka ini memperkenalkan dunia penuh sihir, monster, dan humor satir yang menjadi ciri khas KonoSuba.

programme.title: Uncharted Amazon S1, Ep 3
programme.desc: Deep in the jungles of Peru, a silky anteater is fighting to stay awake and a mother humming bird is struggling to raise her chick. programme.title: HighEnd On TV
programme.desc: HighEnd On TV adalah acara yang menyajikan informasi hangat tentang gaya hidup.

programme.title: The Lounge
programme.desc: The Lounge menghadirkan obrolan santai bersama bintang ternama, membahas karier, kehidupan pribadi, hingga cerita eksklusif dalam suasana hangat dan penuh inspirasi.

programme.title: The Vengeful Beauty
programme.desc: The Flying Guillotine assassins are secretly working for the Emperor and its leader Jin is sent to kill Hon, who knows this secret. Hon’s pregnant wife Rong seeks to kill Jin but retreats to protect her unborn child.

programme.title: Return Of One-Armed Swordsman
programme.desc: The One-Armed Swordsman is forced out of retirement by a criminal organization consisting of eight swordsmen, who has forced every clan to send their best to compete against them for swordsman supremacy.

programme.title: Return Of One-Armed Swordsman
programme.desc: Pendekar Pedang Bertangan Satu dipaksa keluar dari masa pensiunnya oleh sebuah organisasi kriminal yang terdiri dari delapan pendekar pedang, yang telah memaksa setiap klan untuk mengirimkan pendekar pedang terbaik mereka untuk bersaing melawan mereka demi supremasi pendekar pedang.

programme.title: Hong Kong Rhapsody
programme.desc: Hong Kong Rhapsody is a musical extravaganza full of song and dance. Peter Chen-Ho stars as a playboy magician who changes his ways after he becomes the guardian of a young singer.

programme.title: Hong Kong Rhapsody
programme.desc: Hong Kong Rhapsody adalah film musikal yang penuh dengan lagu dan tarian. Peter Chen-Ho berperan sebagai pesulap playboy yang mengubah cara hidupnya setelah menjadi penjaga seorang penyanyi muda.

programme.title: Five Superfighters
programme.desc: A kung fu master and his three students lost everything after they are floored by a bully. To take revenge, the students find ways to learn from other kung fu masters and come back to have a rematch with the bully.

programme.title: Five Superfighters
programme.desc: Seorang ahli kung fu dan tiga muridnya kehilangan segalanya usai dikalahkan oleh seorang penindas. Demi membalas dendam, ketiga murid tersebut berlatih pada master kung fu lainnya dan kembali menghadapi si penindas.

programme.title: Beyond The Great Wall
programme.desc: Wang Zhao Jun refuses to bribe the imperial painter, so he draws an ugly portrait of her, preventing her from being selected by the Emperor until they meet in person.

programme.title: Beyond The Great Wall
programme.desc: Wang Zhao Jun tak mau menyuap seorang pelukis kekaisaran sehingga si pelukis menggambar potret jelek dirinya, yang membuatnya tak dipilih oleh Kaisar sampai mereka bertemu langsung.

programme.title: King Cat
programme.desc: During the Song dynasty, after the upright prefect Bao Zheng executed Pang Yu for embezzlement, the grand tutor Pang Ji sent assassins to avenge his son's death.

programme.title: The Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: This side-splitting comedy sees naive Ah Niu (Ya Feng) head to HK, where he is repeatedly exploited and taken advantage of, and eventually finds himself arrested and imprisoned.

programme.title: The Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: Komedi yang menggelikan ini menampilkan seorang pria lugu bernama Ah Niu. Dia pergi ke Hong Kong dan terus-menerus dieksploitasi dan dimanfaatkan, bahkan ditangkap dan dipenjara.

programme.title: The Fastest Sword
programme.desc: Southern Swordsman Ting is named “The Fastest Sword” but is defeated by a street monk and has to fulfil his promise of working on stone craving with the monk for three years. Ting returns home to lead a peaceful life after that and declines all fight challenges

programme.title: Blue Skies
programme.desc: Cheng Pei-pei stars as a young singer, Hsiao-Yun, struggles between her success in career and her relationship with her pianist lover Li Yen-nan.

programme.title: Blue Skies
programme.desc: Cheng Pei-pei berperan sebagai seorang penyanyi muda bernama Hsiao-Yun yang bimbang antara kesuksesannya dalam karier dan hubungannya dengan sang kekasih, seorang pianis bernama Li Yen-nan.

programme.title: The Sword And The Lute
programme.desc: Kwei Wu and his partner are on a mission to destroy the 'Phoenix Lute', a deadly weapon that shoots poisonous needles and which can only be destroyed by the Kan curved sword.

programme.title: The Sword And The Lute
programme.desc: Kwei Wu dan rekannya tengah melakukan sebuah misi untuk menghancurkan 'Phoenix Lute', sebuah senjata mematikan yang dapat menembakkan jarum-jarum beracun dan hanya dapat dihancurkan oleh pedang lengkung Kan.

programme.title: Illicit Desire
programme.desc: Costume drama auteur Li han-hsiang adapts three erotic and mystic tales from the Chinese classical literatures and visualizes them on screen into an instant cult classic.

programme.title: Illicit Desire
programme.desc: Seorang sineas, Li han-hsiang, mengubah kisah-kisah erotis dan mistis dari kesusasteraan Tiongkok klasik dan mengubahnya menjadi sebuah film yang luar biasa.

programme.title: The Dragon Creek
programme.desc: When her father was ruthlessly murdered during China's early republican era, a young girl has a list of villains who have been plotting against her father and set out on a journey to hunt down the secret serial killer.

programme.title: The Dragon Creek
programme.desc: Saat ayahnya dibunuh dengan kejam pada awal era republik Tiongkok, seorang gadis muda memiliki sebuah daftar penjahat yang telah berkomplot melawan ayahnya dan memulai perjalanan untuk memburu sang pembunuh berantai.

programme.title: Mad Monkey Kung Fu
programme.desc: A former Monkey Kung Fu master crippled by a ruthless villain is convinced by his young disciple to teach him monkey kung fu, so as to avenge his shame.

programme.title: Mad Monkey Kung Fu
programme.desc: Seorang mantan ahli kung fu gaya monyet yang dikalahkan oleh seorang penjahat kejam diyakinkan oleh murid mudanya untuk mengajarinya kung fu gaya monyet demi membalas rasa malunya.

programme.title: Shaolin Rescuers
programme.desc: Hong Xi Guan of Shaolin is chased and wounded by a martial arts scum who took refuge in the Qing court. He is saved and healed by friends from the wet market and they hide Hong in a bean curd shop to protect him.

programme.title: The Young Avenger
programme.desc: Liu seeks out Li to avenge his brother’s death and loses an arm in the fight, vowing revenge ten years later. Li dies after asking his sister to send his daughter Bao Zhu to learn the Dragon Sword skill to avenge his death.

programme.title: The Young Avenger
programme.desc: Liu seeks out Li to avenge his brother’s death and loses an arm in the fight, vowing revenge ten years later. Li dies after asking his sister to send his daughter Bao Zhu to learn the Dragon Sword skill to avenge his death.

programme.title: Hex After Hex
programme.desc: Beloved cult director Kueh Chih Hung delivers this deranged romantic tragedy centring on muscular demon Lo Meng, whose attempts to possess the soul of his true love backfire.

programme.title: Hex After Hex
programme.desc: Kueh Chih Hung, sang sutradara pujaan, menampilkan kisah tragedi romantis tentang arwah Lo Meng yang berupaya merasuk ke dalam tubuh cinta sejatinya, namun upayanya justru menjadi bumerang.

programme.title: The Golden Seal
programme.desc: A family film about a young couple and their son, living in the Aleutian islands and cut off from the world. Like the Aleut natives, the father has long pursued the golden seal, a near-mythical creature.

programme.title: The Golden Seal
programme.desc: Pasangan muda dan anak mereka hidup di pulau Aleusia yang terisolasi dari dunia luar. Seperti penduduk asli Aleusia yang lain, sang ayah telah lama memburu anjing laut emas yang selama ini dianggap sebagai mitos semata.

programme.title: Human Lanterns
programme.desc: Zhao was once defeated by Long in a duel. 7 years later, however, Long asks Zhao to make a unique lantern on his behalf for winning the lantern contest. At the same time, Zhao plans for revenge.

programme.title: Human Lanterns
programme.desc: Zhao pernah dikalahkan oleh Long dalam suatu duel. Tujuh tahun kemudian, Long meminta Zhao membuat sebuah lentera unik atas namanya untuk memenangkan kontes lentera. Zhao pun berencana untuk membalas dendam.

programme.title: House of Traps
programme.desc: It all started with THE FIVE VENOMS, the internationally loved kung-fu thriller which introduced director Chang Cheh's recurring cast of martial arts masters. It continued through more than a dozen high-flying, bloody good entertainments featuring the same action actors in pairs, trios, quartets, and, most memorably, quintets.

programme.title: Young Lovers
programme.desc: Guitar-playing rich kid, Yang Fan, heads to Japan to join a rock 'n' roll band where he soon finds himself competing for the affections of two beautiful girls.

programme.title: Young Lovers
programme.desc: Seorang anak dari keluarga kaya yang gemar bermain gitar bernama Yang Fan pergi ke Jepang untuk bergabung dengan sebuah band rock. Ia juga berusaha mendapatkan cinta dari dua gadis cantik.

programme.title: Return To The 36th Chamber
programme.desc: The second film of the trilogy, Gordon Liu plays Zhou Ren Jie, a man who impersonates a monk in order to learn kung fu in Shaolin, and eventually creates his own Shaolin style of 'scaffolding kung fu'.

programme.title: Return To The 36th Chamber
programme.desc: Dalam bagian ke-dua dari trilogi ini, Gordon Liu berperan sebagai Zhou Ren Jie yang menyamar sebagai biksu untuk belajar kung fu di Shaolin, dan akhirnya menciptakan gaya kungfunya sendiri.

programme.title: Dawn Will Come
programme.desc: Liang Cai drugged the beautiful Qiu Rong and raped her, but promised to marry her after getting his parent's consent. Since then, there is no news of his proposal and she confronts him when she finds herself pregnant.

programme.title: Dawn Will Come
programme.desc: Liang Cai memerkosa Qiu Rong dan berjanji akan menikahinya usai mendapat persetujuan orang tuanya. Namun, tak ada kabar lagi tentang pernikahan tersebut. Qiu pun mendesak Liang Cai saat menyadari bahwa dirinya hamil.

programme.title: Brotherhood
programme.desc: Liu tries to live a respectable life and serve as a loyal member of his triad society. But over time his good intentions lead him into an all-out gang war with a startling conclusion.

programme.title: Brotherhood
programme.desc: Liu berupaya hidup terhormat dan mengabdi sebagai seorang anggota triad yang setia. Namun seiring berjalannya waktu, niat baik Liu membawanya ke dalam perang antargeng tanpa henti dengan dampak yang mengerikan.

programme.title: The 82 Tenants
programme.desc: This story happens in an antiquated compound with various types of tenants. A properties developer contended to acquire the properties for redevelopment.

programme.title: The 82 Tenants
programme.desc: Kisah ini terjadi di sebuah apartemen kuno yang dihuni oleh berbagai karakter. Seorang pengembang properti berupaya memiliki apartemen itu untuk dibangun kembali.

programme.title: The Flag Of Iron
programme.desc: The Flag of Iron, a righteous clan, is in confrontation with the Eagles Society which covers up illicit operations.

programme.title: The Flag Of Iron
programme.desc: Bendera Besi adalah sebuah klan berbudi pekerti luhur yang harus berhadapan dengan Perhimpunan Rajawali yang menjadi pelindung kegiatan-kegiatan ilegal.

programme.title: Spring Blossoms
programme.desc: Some of Shaw Brothers' biggest female stars of the 1970s share the screen in this tale of young love and interfering parents, starring Lily Li, Shu Pei Pei and Essie Lin Chia.

programme.title: Spring Blossoms
programme.desc: Beberapa bintang wanita terbesar Shaw Brothers di tahun 1970-an tampil bersama dalam kisah tentang cinta dan orangtua yang terlampau ikut campur. Dibintangi oleh Lily Li, Shu Pei Pei dan Essie Lin Chia.

programme.title: Shaolin Abbot
programme.desc: International favorite, David Chiang, stars as the great Chih Shim, the monk who saved the Southern Shaolin Temple. Joining him is Lo Lieh, the Shaws' first international star who returns to his famous role of Shaolin renegade Pai Mei. The result is a true martial arts epic.

programme.title: Heads For Sale
programme.desc: Hua is an upright and brave swordswoman who will stand up against villains and do anything for Luo, the man she loves. When Luo is sent to jail by the corrupted police, she sets out to free him.

programme.title: Heads For Sale
programme.desc: Hua adalah pendekar pedang wanita nan jujur dan pemberani yang akan melawan penjahat dan melakukan apa pun demi Luo, pria yang ia cintai. Saat Luo dijebloskan ke penjara oleh polisi korup, ia berusaha membebaskannya.

programme.title: The Golden Knight
programme.desc: The heroine Yu Fei Xia is accused of stealing the book of martial arts secrets. To prove her innocence, she disguises herself as a man and finds her way into the Shaolin Temple to find out the truth.

programme.title: The Golden Knight
programme.desc: The heroine Yu Fei Xia is accused of stealing the book of martial arts secrets. To prove her innocence, she disguises herself as a man and finds her way into the Shaolin Temple to find out the truth.

programme.title: Double Bliss
programme.desc: Ching Li stars in the story of two students looking to persuade their parents to bless their marriage. The lovebirds hatch what they think is a foolproof plan: they play dead!

programme.title: Double Bliss
programme.desc: Ching Li berperan dalam kisah tentang dua pelajar yang berupaya membujuk orangtua mereka untuk merestui pernikahan mereka. Pasangan kekasih ini menjalankan sebuah rencana yang mereka kira mudah: berpura-pura mati!

programme.title: Legend Of The Fox
programme.desc: Chang Cheh directs a very young Chin Siu Ho as Hu Fei, the orphaned son of a heroic warrior, who sets out to confront the renowned swordsmen responsible for his parents' deaths.

programme.title: Legend Of The Fox
programme.desc: Dalam film arahan sutradara Chang Cheh ini, Chin Siu Ho berperan sebagai Hu Fei, putra mendiang seorang pahlawan. Ia bertekad untuk melawan para pendekar pedang terkenal yang bertanggung jawab atas kematian orangtuanya.

programme.title: Madam White Snake
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai is perfect as Pak Su-cheng, the stunning snake goddess who assumes a womanly form so that she can taste the pleasures of a human life!

programme.title: Madam White Snake
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai memerankan tokoh Pak Su-cheng, dewi ular nan mempesona yang memilih wujud sebagai seorang wanita sehingga ia dapat merasakan indahnya kehidupan manusia!

programme.title: The Kid With A Tattoo
programme.desc: Young Wang Yu witnesses the brutal murder of his kung fu master by Yuen Wah's vicious villain. Although he escapes, the killer saw the large eagle emblazoned on our hero's chest.

programme.title: The Kid With A Tattoo
programme.desc: Wang Yu muda menyaksikan pembunuhan brutal guru kung fu-nya yang dilakukan oleh penjahat kejam Yuen Wah. Yu berhasil lolos, namun sang pembunuh sempat melihat elang besar yang tergambar di dada Yu.

programme.title: Inside The Forbidden City
programme.desc: The tale of two imperial concubines vying for the emperor's favor.

programme.title: The Mighty One
programme.desc: Lung seeks five volumes of a renowned Kung Fu manual to gain invincibility. When he believes a martial arts school master possesses the volumes, he kills him and his daughter but leaves behind a young brother and sister.

programme.title: Dream Of The Red Chamber
programme.desc: Pao-yu is in love with his cousin, Lin Tai-yu, but his family has other marital plans for him that will leave both broken-hearted.

programme.title: Dream Of The Red Chamber
programme.desc: Pao-yu jatuh cinta pada sepupunya, Lin Tai-yu, tetapi keluarganya memiliki rencana pernikahan lain untuknya yang akan membuat keduanya patah hati.

programme.title: Challenge of the Masters
programme.desc: Young Wong Fei Hung must prove himself worthy to be taught by Master Lu, who was also his father’s martial arts teacher. Although he is defeated in a competition, Wong Fei Hung’s passion in Kung Fu finally moves Lu and allows him to become Lu’s disciple.

programme.title: Carry On Doctors And Nurses
programme.desc: Director Chan Friend created this delightful variation on the British 'Carry On!' film series. It can certainly make you laugh with all the comical acts happened in the Hospital!

programme.title: Carry On Doctors And Nurses
programme.desc: Sutradara Chan Friend membuat variasi yang menarik dalam film seri asal Inggris 'Carry On!'. Film ini akan membuat Anda tertawa dengan semua aksi lucu yang terjadi di Rumah Sakit!

programme.desc: The film's story unfolds in the fictional country of Laika and in Hong Kong, China. A police academy student who has not yet graduated, Ashan (played by Gu Bin), is tasked with a dangerous mission. He helps the criminal organization by eliminating obstacles for their leader, Atian (played by An Zhi Jie), in prison. Ashan approaches Atian, gains his trust, and collects evidence against the criminal group. After both of them are released from prison, Ashan assists Atian in rising within the criminal organization in Hong Kong. After enduring numerous challenges, Atian successfully replaces the group's leader, Bao Ge (played by Zeng Zhiwei), becoming the new boss and taking control of the organization. However, just as Ashan is about to complete his mission, his true identity is exposed.

programme.title: Freetown
programme.desc: A group of native Liberian missionaries make a desperate cross-country trip through their war torn country to save one of their own.

programme.title: Freetown
programme.desc: Sekelompok misionaris asli Liberia melakukan perjalanan lintas negara yang penuh keputusasaan melalui negara mereka yang dilanda perang untuk menyelamatkan salah satu dari mereka.

programme.title: Sky Dog
programme.desc: High school senior Colt Lifestone dreams of earning his pilot's license while living a quiet life until he discovers that his mother is secretly working as a CIA agent. When she is captured during a dangerous mission, Colt joins forces with his loyal dog Oreo and his friend Alice on a daring rescue mission. Along the way, they uncover double agents, face thrilling challenges, and prove that courage, friendship, and determination can overcome even the toughest obstacles.

programme.title: Sky Dog
programme.desc: Colt Lifestone, seorang siswa SMA yang bercita-cita menjadi pilot, menjalani kehidupan yang tenang hingga mengetahui bahwa ibunya sebenarnya adalah agen rahasia CIA. Ketika sang ibu diculik dalam sebuah operasi berbahaya, Colt bersama anjing setianya, Oreo, dan sahabat barunya, Alice, memulai misi penyelamatan yang penuh aksi. Dalam perjalanan, mereka harus menghadapi berbagai rintangan, mengungkap keberadaan agen ganda, dan membuktikan bahwa keberanian, kerja sama, serta tekad yang kuat mampu membawa mereka menghadapi ancaman yang paling berbahaya.

programme.title: Delia's Gone
programme.desc: Accused of murdering his sister, a man with an intellectual disability embarks on a quest to clear his name and find out who's responsible.

programme.title: Delia's Gone
programme.desc: Dituduh membunuh saudara perempuannya, seorang pria penyandang disabilitas intelektual memulai upaya untuk membersihkan namanya dan mencari tahu siapa yang bertanggung jawab.

programme.title: Nightmare Alley: Possession
programme.desc: A grifter working his way up from low-ranking carnival worker to lauded psychic medium matches wits with a psychologist bent on exposing him.

programme.title: Nightmare Alley: Possession
programme.desc: Seorang penipu yang berusaha naik dari pekerja karnaval rendahan menjadi medium paranormal terkenal harus adu kecerdikan dengan seorang psikolog yang bertekad membongkar tipu dayanya.

programme.title: After The Wedding
programme.desc: A manager of an orphanage in Kolkata travels to New York to meet a benefactor.

programme.title: Faith Heist
programme.desc: When a charismatic preacher finds his church in financial ruin after being swindled by a shady financial advisor, he rallies members of his congregation to pull off a heist to get their money back and save the church before it's too late.

programme.title: Faith Heist
programme.desc: Ketika seorang pendeta karismatik mendapati gerejanya mengalami kehancuran finansial setelah ditipu oleh seorang penasihat keuangan yang licik, ia mengumpulkan anggota jemaatnya untuk melakukan perampokan guna mendapatkan kembali uang mereka dan menyelamatkan gereja sebelum terlambat.

programme.title: Derailed

programme.title: Knockouts!: Morales Vs Maidana
programme.desc: The main event in this episode is an interim WBA light welterweight title fight between Erik Morales and Marcos Maidana that gave Maidana a chance to leap back into the boxing title scene, while Morales provided fans with a vintage performance. Also on the card, action from WBO welterweight champ Carlos Quintanta.

programme.title: Knockouts!: Morales Vs Maidana
programme.desc: Pertandingan utama dalam episode ini adalah perebutan gelar juara sementara kelas welter ringan WBA antara Erik Morales dan Marcos Maidana, yang memberikan kesempatan bagi Maidana untuk kembali ke kancah perebutan gelar tinju, sementara Morales memberikan penampilan klasik bagi para penggemar. Juga ada aksi dari juara kelas welter WBO, Carlos Quintanta.

programme.title: Judo For The World S1, Ep 13
programme.desc: Judo for the World features the best competitors in the sport as they compete in a global tour for an opportunity to vie for the gold in the World Judo Championship. In this episode we see the best Judo from the Abu Dhabi Grand Slam on world Judo day, we speak to double world champion Mayra Aguiar about the unity of the Brazilian judo team.

programme.title: Judo For The World S1, Ep 13
programme.desc: Judo for the World menampilkan para kompetitor terbaik dalam olahraga ini saat mereka berkompetisi dalam tur global untuk memperebutkan emas di Kejuaraan Judo Dunia. Dalam episode ini kita melihat Judo terbaik dari Abu Dhabi Grand Slam pada hari Judo dunia, kami berbicara dengan juara dunia ganda Mayra Aguiar tentang persatuan tim judo Brasil.

programme.title: FS MMA: Szpilka Vs Zimmerman
programme.desc: FS MMA: Szpilka Vs Zimmerman features a heavyweight showdown between Artur Szpilka and Tomasz Zimmerman. Szpilka brings his experience and powerful striking, while Zimmerman looks to use his own strength and fighting skills to challenge his opponent.

programme.title: FS MMA: Szpilka Vs Zimmerman
programme.desc: FS MMA: Szpilka Vs Zimmerman menghadirkan duel kelas berat antara Artur Szpilka dan Tomasz Zimmerman. Szpilka mengandalkan pengalaman serta kekuatan serangannya, sementara Zimmerman berusaha memanfaatkan kekuatan dan kemampuan bertarungnya untuk memberikan perlawanan.

programme.desc: Masuki dunia fantasi Enchantimals! Sekelompok gadis menggemaskan yang setengah hewan dan setengah manusia, yang memiliki ikatan istimewa dengan sahabat hewan kesayangan mereka yang menggemaskan.

programme.title: Barbie Dreamtopia
programme.desc: Barbie and her little sister Chelsea travel through the whimsical worlds of Dreamtopia. Through the eyes of Chelsea's imagination, viewers explore delicious and delightful worlds and meet colorful characters who live there.

programme.title: Barbie Dreamtopia
programme.desc: Barbie dan adik perempuannya, Chelsea, menjelajahi dunia-dunia ajaib di Dreamtopia. Melalui imajinasi Chelsea, penonton menjelajahi dunia-dunia yang menakjubkan dan menyenangkan serta bertemu dengan tokoh-tokoh penuh warna yang tinggal di sana.

programme.title: Laluna
programme.desc: La Luna is a beautiful animated short film by Pixar Animation Studios, released in 2011 and directed by Enrico Casarosa. The story follows a young boy on a magical nighttime journey with his father and grandfather, where he discovers the family’s secret job on the Moon.

programme.title: Sahabat Selamanya Upin & Ipin
programme.desc: The fun and hilarious daily life of Upin & Ipin with their friends who have different personalities and backgrounds, including Mei-Mei, Jarjit Singh, Ehsan, Fizi, Mail, and Susanti.

programme.title: Sahabat Selamanya Upin & Ipin
programme.desc: Kehidupan sehari-hari Upin & Ipin yang menyenangkan dan penuh kelucuan bersama teman-teman mereka yang memiliki kepribadian dan latar belakang berbeda-beda, diantaranya Mei-Mei, Jarjit Singh, Ehsan, Fizi, Mail, dan Susanti.

programme.title: Morphle
programme.desc: Mila's dad runs the only magic pet store in the city - a fantastical place where you can find all sorts of cute and quirky pets who each have their own unique magic powers, and he has gifted Mila the most magic pet of all, Morphle.

programme.title: Morphle
programme.desc: Ayah Mila mengelola satu-satunya toko hewan peliharaan ajaib di kota ini - tempat yang fantastis di mana Anda bisa menemukan berbagai macam hewan peliharaan yang lucu dan unik, yang masing-masing memiliki kekuatan sihir yang unik, dan dia telah menghadiahkan hewan peliharaan paling ajaib untuk Mila, yaitu Morphle.

programme.title: Entong Animasi
programme.desc: Animasi buatan Indonesia yang bercerita berdasarkan sinetron terkenal yaitu Si Entong yang masih bercerita tentang Memed dan Tibo yang bermusuhan dengan Entong.

programme.title: Kiko S4
programme.desc: Kiko season 4 tak hanya menyuguhkan aksi dan petualangan seru, namun juga pesan moral tentang persahabatan, perjuangan, kebenaran, dan pengorbanan.

programme.title: Bima S

programme.title: Petualangan Upin & Ipin

programme.desc: The Cantonese hero Fong Sai Yuk becomes involved in the secret brotherhood "The Red Flower", who are trying to overthrow the Manchurian emperor and re-establishing the Ming dynasty. programme.title: Fong Sai-Yuk, Return Of Heroes

programme.title: CIPUNG ABUBU

Fairy dust mengubah para bayi menjadi bayi-bayi ajaib dan membawa mereka ke dunia boba, tempat untuk anak-anak di mana semua keajaiban bisa terjadi dan tanpa diketahui orang dewasa. Sejak saat itulah petualangan dimulai. programme.title: RAINBOW BUBBLEGEM

programme.title: SUNNY GIRL NO.23
programme.desc: **SUNNY GIRL NO.23** is not only about the growth journey of a cheerful young girl, but also the first realistic-themed animated series that reflects parent-child education and school life in China. The main character is an 8-year-old elementary school student. She is not extraordinary. She is a clumsy girl, but also energetic, optimistic, and kind-hearted, with a talent for drawing, creativity, and problem-solving abilities that many children can relate to. This animation has been well received by audiences in Mainland China and has also been distributed across Southeast Asia, including Malaysia and Vietnam. The first season expresses a worldview through 26 humorous stories: *"There are many different forms of excellence, and every child is exceptional in their own way."* It not only portrays the childhood experiences of contemporary elementary school students but also explores the clash between traditional and modern parenting concepts. The second season continues and further develops this worldview.

programme.title: SUNNY GIRL NO.23
programme.desc: SUNNY GIRL NO.23 BUKAN HANYA TENTANG PERJALANAN PERTUMBUHAN SEORANG GADIS CERIA, TETAPI JUGA SERIAL ANIMASI BERTEMA REALISTIS PERTAMA YANG MENCERMINKAN PENDIDIKAN ORANGTUA-ANAK DAN KEHIDUPAN SEKOLAH DI TIONGKOK. TOKOH UTAMANYA ADALAH SEORANG SISWA SEKOLAH DASAR BERUSIA 8 TAHUN. DIA TIDAK LUAR BIASA. DIA ADALAH SEORANG GADIS DENGAN KARAKTER CEROBOH TETAPI DIA ADALAH GADIS YANG ENERGIK, OPTIMIS, DAN BAIK HATI YANG BERBAKAT DALAM MENGGAMBAR DENGAN KREATIVITAS DAN MEMILIKI KEMAMPUAN DALAM MEMECAHKAN MASALAH, YANG DAPAT DITEMUKAN OLEH SEBAGIAN BESAR ANAK-ANAK. ANIMASI INI DISUKAI OLEH PENONTON DI TIONGKOK DARATAN, DAN TELAH DIDISTRIBUSIKAN KE ASIA TENGGARA TERMASUK MALAYSIA DAN VIETNAM. MUSIM PERTAMA MENGEKSPRESIKAN PANDANGAN DUNIA DENGAN 26 CERITA LUCU, YAITU "ADA BEGITU BANYAK BENTUK KEUNGGULAN YANG BERBEDA, SETIAP ANAK UNGGUL DENGAN KELEBIHANNYA", TIDAK HANYA MENGHADIRKAN MASA KECIL SISWA SEKOLAH DASAR KONTEMPORER, TETAPI JUGA BENTURAN ANTARA KONSEP PENGASUHAN LAMA DAN BARU. MUSIM KEDUA MEMBAWA DAN MENINGKATKAN PANDANGAN DUNIA INI.

programme.title: MADUN
programme.desc: The Madun series tells the story of Madun (16 years old) and his journey to achieve his dream of becoming a soccer player. His father, Syafei (50 years old), who is of Medan descent, really wants his son to become an Islamic teacher. Because of this, Syafei always hinders Madun's efforts to achieve his dream. For him, Madun only has one choice, which is to become a religious scholar. Madun's mother, Kirana, a native of Batavia, is torn. She must obey her husband, who is anti-soccer. However, on the other hand, she also does not want to prevent Madun from realizing his dreams. She cannot bear to restrain Madun, who loves soccer. However, to realize his dream, Madun faces a lot of competition.

programme.title: MADUN
programme.desc: Serial madun menceritakan perjalanan hidup madun (16 tahun) dalam memperjuangkan cita-citanya menjadi pesepakbola. Ayahnya, syafei (50 tahun) keturunan medan sangat menginginkan anaknya menjadi ustadz. Karena itu. Syafei selalu menghalangi upaya madun mencapai cita-citanya itu. baginya, pilihan madun hanya satu. Yakni jadi ahli agama. Ibunya madun, yaitu kirana asli batavia serba salah, dia harus patuh pada suami anti bola. Namun di sisi lain ia juga tidak ingin menghalangi madun mewujudkan cita-citanya. Ia tak tega mengekang madun yang mencintai bola. Namun untuk mewujudkan mimpinya. madun menghadapi banyak persaingan.

They give parents the opportunity to teach and play with their children as they watch together.

programme.title: COCOMELON IND

programme.title: NUMBERBLOCKS
programme.desc: Numberblocks is an educational animated series for preschoolers that teaches mathematical concepts through lively, adventurous number block characters. Each number block has its own numerical value and unique personality. They join forces and interact with each other to solve mathematical problems while teaching basic mathematical concepts such as addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, and other concepts. Each episode of “Numberblocks” typically features a short story in which the number blocks work together to complete a task or face a mathematical challenge. programme.title: TAYO, THE LITTLE BUS
programme.desc: In a big city where various vehicles happily coexist, the little bus Tayo has just started learning his route around town. There are many things for Tayo to learn. Tayo and his friends, Rogi, Lani, and Gani, help each other to become great grown-up buses.

programme.title: TAYO, THE LITTLE BUS
programme.desc: Di kota besar di mana berbagai kendaraan dengan senang hati hidup bersama, bus kecil tayo baru saja mulai mempelajari rutenya di kota. Ada banyak hal yang harus dipelajari tayo. tayo dan teman-temannya, rogi, lani dan gani saling membantu untuk menjadi bus dewasa yang hebat.

programme.title: KATURI

Mother Flora always encourages her children to explore the world with other animals and helps them whenever they need it. When the peacock chicks encounter difficulties or even danger, Mother Flora is always there to keep them safe.
